newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia rate cut could save farmers A$80mln-govt.
newsitem.headline: Australia rate cut could save farmers A$80mln-govt.

text.p: Australian Primary Industries Minister John Anderson said on Monday farmers could save up to A$80 million as a result of last week's interest rate cut.

"Friday's interest rate cuts, assuming they are passed on in full by the Australian financial institutions, could slash a further A$80 million from farm costs in this country," Anderson told parliament.
The Reserve Bank of Australia eased monetary policy on Friday, cutting its overnight cash rate target by 0.5 percentage point to 5.5 percent. It was the fourth rate cut since July.
